comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-filter-annotations.mitcad-ui (GitHub #388): Sketch1 (F1) on XY, two lines 30 mm long and 10 mm apart: c3 from the fixed point p1 at (5, 0) (a Fix symbol; a fixed point at the origin is taken as the sketch origin, which shows none), Horizontal k4 on it; c6 above it, Parallel k7 to it, and the dimension k8 of 10 between them. Two fixed points frame the view so that after a fit the window and the clicks stay in its free part (also in session 0's 1024x768 window on Windows).
